newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares fall in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares fall in subdued trade.

text.p: Jordanian stocks dropped 0.35 percent on Sunday in a quiet market.
The official 60-share Amman Financial Market (AFM) index fell 0.53 points to 151.81 points in turnover of just 280,000 dinars ($395,000).
Brokers said activity on the bourse was doubly hit by lack of international investor activity over the Western weekend and a local bank holiday for Orthodox Easter.
"There were not many people to activate the market," said Mohammad Abdallah of Pearl Consulting.
"It's just depended on the mood of the traders on the floor. There has been no real trend for the last two weeks," Abdallah said.

Jordan Ceramic Factory was the most heavily traded share on Sunday. Stocks worth 72,000 dinars changed hands but brokers said most of that was in a single block trade. Jordan Ceramic closed unchanged on 7.10 dinars.
Overall falling shares outnumbered gainers by 23 to four, with another 13 trading but closing unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 best-performing shares in terms of turnover and financial performance fell 0.76 points to 80.41 points, 3.57 percent down from the start of the year.
